claims.behavior_proved: Separate tenant-bound temporary credentials (72-hour fixed expiry) and permanent password records are persisted through PostgreSQL. Unique plaintext canaries prove temporary and permanent secret values do not appear in repository results, direct database rows, or captured application logs. Persisted hashes are Argon2id m=19456 KiB/t=2/p=1; correct secrets verify and incorrect secrets fail. Temporary credential consumption and permanent credential establishment are atomic and one-use. Password policy uses the approved 12 Unicode code-point minimum, preserves the full supplied string, and rejects common/compromised entries from the bundled local corpus.
claims.path_proved: Focused credential lifecycle unit tests passed (5 tests); PostgreSQL migration integration suite passed (16 tests) using actual PostgresCredentialRepository persistence; API suite passed (21 tests) including captured Fastify application-log canaries. Blocklist integrity validation, typecheck, architecture, toolchain and Phase 1 contract checks passed. See retained command outputs.
